resources.string: Lets Rivet read the screen and tap, type and scroll in other apps when you ask it to. Rivet never reads or types passwords, shows a Stop button while it works, and asks you before anything that sends, pays or deletes.
Ask Rivet for anything: your day, your texts, a call back.
